name: Automatic Data Processing, Inc.
summary: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 71/100 (Interessant), Innovations-Score 26/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 317.32 USD (+0 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
